CEO reflects on employee's death, expressing lingering guilt

Vivek Mehra, founder and CEO of Vikramshila Research, shared reflections on the untimely death of an employee, marking the anniversary of the event. He stated that he "remains guilty even to this day" and clarified that the employee "wasn't murdered." The post revisited the tragedy and the founder's enduring feelings about it.
